notes.title: Welcome to the VISEGUNNE Community Steam Page!
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you![/h3]
We're so thrilled to be able to share our new trailer and officially announce VISEGUNNE to the public. We hope you're excited about the game and we're looking forward to showing you all more in the future. 

[previewyoutube=ktzkxJxf9Ss;full][/previewyoutube]

Make sure you add VISEGUNNE to your wishlist so we can notify you of new updates and announcements from our team.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2882040/

[h3]How to support us[/h3]
If you want to support VISEGUNNE further, sharing the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ktzkxJxf9Ss]the game's trailer on Youtube[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2882040/VISEGUNNE/]VISEGUNNE's Steam page link[/url] with your friends goes a long way. We're still trying to spread the word and we cannot thank you enough for your support. If you have any questions about the game feel free to reach out to us on Steam's community boards or over social media.

Thanks again and stay tuned!
